question: How many customers are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer

question: List the names of all genres.
gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM Genre

question: How many tracks are in the database?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track

question: List the titles of all albums by the artist AC/DC.
gold_sql: SELECT al.Title FROM Album al JOIN Artist ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId WHERE ar.Name = 'AC/DC'

question: Which country has the most customers?
gold_sql: SELECT Country FROM Customer GROUP BY Country ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the total revenue across all invoices?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(Total) FROM Invoice

question: Which artist has the most albums?
gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name FROM Artist ar JOIN Album al ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many employees are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Employee

question: What is the name of the longest track?
gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM Track ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the average invoice total?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(Total) FROM Invoice

question: How many invoices were issued in 2023?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2023'

question: What are the top 3 billing countries by total sales? Give the country and total.
gold_sql: SELECT BillingCountry, SUM(Total) FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY SUM(Total) DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which genre has the most tracks?
gold_sql: SELECT g.Name FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: List the first and last names of customers from Brazil.
gold_sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Brazil'

question: What are the first and last names of the employee who reports to nobody?
gold_sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Employee WHERE ReportsTo IS NULL

question: How many tracks are longer than 5 minutes?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track WHERE Milliseconds > 300000

question: What is the highest unit price of any track?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(UnitPrice) FROM Track

question: List all media type names.
gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM MediaType

question: How many playlists are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Playlist

question: How many tracks are in the playlist named Grunge?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PlaylistTrack pt JOIN Playlist p ON p.PlaylistId = pt.PlaylistId WHERE p.Name = 'Grunge'

question: How many individual tracks have been sold in total (sum of invoice line quantities)?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(Quantity) FROM InvoiceLine

question: Which customer has spent the most in total? Give first and last name.
gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName ORDER BY SUM(i.Total) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which genre generated the most revenue from invoice lines?
gold_sql: SELECT g.Name FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name ORDER BY SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the total invoice revenue for each year? Give the year and the total.
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate), SUM(Total) FROM Invoice GROUP BY strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate)

question: Which support rep (employee) has the most customers assigned? Give first and last name.
gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many employees were hired in 2003 or later?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Employee WHERE strftime('%Y', HireDate) >= '2003'

question: What is the average track length in seconds?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(Milliseconds) / 1000.0 FROM Track

question: How many albums have more than 15 tracks?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT AlbumId FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId HAVING COUNT(*) > 15)

question: How many artists have no albums?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Artist WHERE ArtistId NOT IN (SELECT ArtistId FROM Album)

question: Which artist has the most tracks in the Jazz genre?
gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name FROM Artist ar JOIN Album al ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Jazz' GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which customers have spent more than 45 dollars in total? Give first and last name.
gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName HAVING SUM(i.Total) > 45

question: What is the total sales amount handled by each support rep? Give first name, last name and total.
gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, SUM(i.Total) FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName

question: How many distinct billing cities appear in invoices?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT BillingCity) FROM Invoice

question: Which album has the longest total duration? Give the title.
gold_sql: SELECT al.Title FROM Album al JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId GROUP BY al.AlbumId, al.Title ORDER BY SUM(t.Milliseconds) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many customers do not have a company listed?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer WHERE Company IS NULL

question: Which billing country has the highest average invoice total?
gold_sql: SELECT BillingCountry FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY AVG(Total) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which countries have more than 4 customers? Give the country and the number of customers.
gold_sql: SELECT Country, COUNT(*) FROM Customer GROUP BY Country HAVING COUNT(*) > 4

question: What percentage of all tracks belong to the Rock genre?
gold_sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN g.Name = 'Rock' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId

question: How many invoices have a total greater than 10?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice WHERE Total > 10

question: List the names of tracks on the album Let There Be Rock.
gold_sql: SELECT t.Name FROM Track t JOIN Album al ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId WHERE al.Title = 'Let There Be Rock'
